objective: Implement the core Flutter UX screens and navigation shell for Home, Inbox, Projects, Tasks, Meetings, Search, Reports, Import, Export, Settings, and Archive using the local-first application services already present in the mobile package.
environment_prerequisites: Flutter SDK is installed and available on PATH.
Dart is available through the Flutter installation.
The mobile package shell exists under mobile/field_work_agent/.
success_criteria: The Flutter app has a usable navigation shell that covers the primary screen groups from docs/ux-screen-plan.md.
Home, Inbox, Projects, Tasks, Meetings, Search, Reports, Import, Export, Settings, and Archive have concrete Flutter presentation surfaces instead of a single placeholder page.
The UI reads from local-first application services or presentation adapters and does not introduce sync or hosted backend assumptions.
Low-confidence and review-required states remain visible in the UI for inbox and meeting-driven flows.
The work stays within the existing local-only v1 product scope.
stop_conditions: The Flutter toolchain preflight fails and the task would require runtime validation or generated platform runners.
The task requires changing canonical product docs instead of implementing against them.
The requested UI work requires a new design-system direction not already implied by docs/ux-screen-plan.md.
approval_gates: Introducing a new UI framework or state-management package beyond what the package already uses.
Expanding scope into sync, shared backend, or multi-user behavior.
Adding platform-specific generated files outside the current mobile package shell.
deliverables: Presentation adapters for local application services
Basic widget coverage for the new shell
notes: Use the stable repo-local preflight command before treating Flutter runtime work as unblocked.
Prefer incremental screen implementation over a large one-shot UI rewrite.
